name: campus-ita-mais
description: Campus 3D da UFS Itabaiana com acompanhamento dos projetos da gestão

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.data-e2e',{recursive:true,force:true})" && playwright test -c e2e
